name: yunikorn-core-causal-scheduler-mutation-traces
instr:
Apache YuniKorn cannot track node, application, and allocation updates from RM admission through scheduler completion and emitted events. Add tracked updates that return immediately with a stable receipt, support waiting, and expose a bounded, causally ordered trace. Preserve existing untracked update behavior and event meanings.

Keep each mutation's non-empty identity, RM identity, and update family isolated through dispatch, normalized partition processing, completion, lookup, and serialization. Every accepted receipt must reach MutationSucceeded or MutationFailed with a useful reason, including interrupted shutdown work. Preserve existing validation, request mutation, callbacks, returns, and shutdown ordering.

Record caused application, allocation, node, queue, and allocation-request events as contiguous MutationObservation entries without changing EventRecord payloads, diagnostic aggregation, or rate limiting. Suppressed events consume no sequence. Never evict pending work. Missing identifiers return ErrMutationTraceNotFound with exact text "mutation trace not found".

Provide in-process access through events.GetEventSystem, EventSystem.GetMutationTrace, and EventSystem.ConfigureMutationStore. GET /ws/v1/events/mutation/:id must expose the identical MutationTrace through MutationTraceDAOInfo and MutationObservationDAOInfo with established not-found behavior. Public locations are github.com/apache/yunikorn-core/pkg/mutation, github.com/apache/yunikorn-core/pkg/rmproxy, g
